sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Export Distribution of Pre-Packaged Spicy Tallow Hotpot Base Bricks

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Customary Law; former Anglo-French Condominium)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus, signed 2017, in force 2020
Agreement between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Vanuatu on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2006)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended, incl. the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015 and the Beneficial Ownership (Registration) Regulations 2016); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017; Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2010; Registered Agents and Nominee Companies Act [Cap 246]; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and VFIU Guidelines.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (register maintained by the licensed registered agent on a private internal basis; disclosed to the VFSC Registrar and VFIU upon lawful demand; not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the valid passport (or national identity card) of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport/ID issuing authority of the holder's home jurisdiction, with notarization by a licensed notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu has signed but not ratified the HCCH 1961 Apostille Convention; legalization via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs / diplomatic post, or the parallel chain in the document's country of origin)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / police clearance certificate for each individual UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police force / criminal records bureau of the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same chain as above; must bear a notarized certification before consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter and six-month bank statements substantiating source of funds and commercial standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the applicant's transactional account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank certification, then notary certification, then consular channel where the bank letter is to be invoked as a sworn exhibit)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate dossier of any corporate UBO (certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, certificate of incumbency, and register of directors)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry and licensed registered agent of the UBO's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (certification by the home-jurisdiction registry, notarization, then consular channel)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Independent third-party AML, PEP, and sanctions screening report covering all directors, shareholders, signatories, and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed AML screening provider / the Vanuatu registered agent's compliance department
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Rendered internally in original form; notarization required only if the report is to form part of a sworn statutory declaration; no consular step applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD and EDD under Part 4 of the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2017. Every director, shareholder, authorized signatory, and 25%+ UBO must be screened against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU financial sanctions, Commonwealth/Interpol notices, and the Vanuatu FIU domestic list. Foreign PEPs, their family members, and close associates trigger EDD, senior-management approval, and source-of-wealth verification. Negative news and adverse-media checks are compulsory for the low-risk wholesale tier before onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — e-Services Portal (applications must be transmitted through a licensed Vanuatu registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are Bislama, English, and French. The registered name must be rendered in the Latin alphabet; a non-Latin (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic) secondary name may be recorded only in conjunction with a romanized primary name. The VFSC rejects names that are identical, confusingly similar, misleading, or contrary to public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the applicant's registered agent must file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, attaching any ministerial or sectoral consent, or a revised transliteration. If the refusal is upheld, the applicant may appeal administratively to the Registrar and, thereafter, apply for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 28 days of the final decision. A name may be re-reserved on payment of a further fee before expiry; cumulative reservation beyond 90 days requires proof of imminent incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office: the International Companies Act requires a physical registered office at the premises of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila. A virtual administrative office may be used for back-office functions but cannot satisfy statutory address, record-keeping, or service-of-process requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for this industry: approximately 10-15% annualized likelihood of an unannounced VFSC/VFIU compliance inspection. The low-risk wholesale distribution tier, absence of local physical operations, and use of a licensed registered agent materially reduce, but do not eliminate, inspection risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and reservation fee (single name; includes one reconsideration re-filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (via licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC fee schedule; prevailing market tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (authorized capital below USD 10,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC gazetted incorporation tariff (International Companies Act [Cap 222], Second Schedule); no minimum paid-up capital applies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation and statutory company files (minute book, share certificates, registers)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registrar fee and standard registered-agent document preparation charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office services (first annual period)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident International Companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client due diligence, UBO verification, PEP/sanctions screening, and VFIU report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent compliance desk / licensed screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML/CFT Act 2017 CDD obligations; market benchmark per onboarding file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, certification, and consular legalization of the KYC/UBO document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public(s) and Vanuatu consular/diplomatic authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff and consular fee schedule; varies by country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, sworn translations (where applicable), and banking-format attestations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for international courier and certified translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 6–10 (incorporation), s. 18 (registered office), s. 30 (directors); Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; VFSC Registrar's Rules 2013.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the Statement of Particulars (Form IC-1) filed with the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; International Companies may issue shares with or without par value and capital may be subscribed but unpaid at incorporation; no escrow or capital deposit requirement applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers do hereby subscribe to the shares set opposite their respective names in the capital of the Company in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be established at [address in Vanuatu] and that the company seal, books, and registers be kept at such address. RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] be and hereby are appointed as the first Directors of the Company, and [Name] be appointed as Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting or until earlier resignation or removal. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and take all steps necessary to give effect to these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – pre-registration name search unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed company name (and up to two alternatives) to the VFSC enterprise portal. The Registry will screen against existing registered names and prohibited terms under the International Companies Act, then reserve an acceptable name for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Proposed name in English
Identification document of the beneficial owner or corporate director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to confusing similarity or prohibited wording, the applicant may file a formal appeal with VFSC within 14 days or select a revised name and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarisation of Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC in coordination with a licensed Notary Public in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association and complete the Statement of Particulars (Form IC-1). Execute the documents in accordance with the International Companies Act and have the subscriber identification documents notarised by a registered notary.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed)
Statement of Particulars (Form IC-1)
Consent to act as Registered Agent (original)
Notarised passports or corporate registry extracts of every shareholder and director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry determines that any document is defective or incomplete, it will issue a compliance query; the applicant must amend and resubmit within 30 calendar days, after which the application lapses unless an extension is granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Treasury Division / online payment gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official filing fee of USD 350 plus optional expedite fees through the VFSC online portal or designated bank transfer. Retain the automated receipt as proof of payment.
required_dossiers: VFSC payment receipt or remittance advice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is rejected or incorrectly applied, contact the VFSC treasury with the payment reference; the Registry will reconcile or refund within 7 business days, and the application clock restarts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete application packet electronically to the VFSC portal. The Registrar verifies compliance, enters the company onto the International Companies Register, and issues the formal Certificate of Incorporation together with the certified constitution.
required_dossiers: Fully executed incorporation application (Form IC-1)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (bound copy)
Consent of Registered Agent
Statutory declarations of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query is raised during review, the Registry will notify the agent; the applicant must respond within 21 days with corrective documentation. If the matter is not cured, a fresh filing may be required with no loss of priority for a new name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Office of the Company; first directors are the presiding authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a physical or tacit meeting of the first board of directors at the registered office. Adopt the first board resolution, open statutory registers, issue share certificates, and record the registered office address in the minute book.
required_dossiers: Minutes of First Board Meeting (executed)
Share certificates issued to subscribers
Register of members, directors, shareholders and charges
Signed copy of the pro-forma board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any formal defect is later identified (such as share issuance inconsistent with the statement of particulars), the directors must pass a ratifying resolution and file an amendment with VFSC; the registry will accept after correction within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Attestation and Certified Copies for Commercial Counterparties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry Office and accredited notary in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, Constitution, and current directors' register for opening bank accounts and completing letters of credit arrangements with counterparties. If the export destination country requires legalisation, obtain notarial certification and consular apostille where applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (original)
Certified constitution and articles of association
Tax registration letter (if requested)
Certified passport copy of the signatory director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certified copy is rejected by a foreign party, request re-certification from the VFSC with an explanatory memo; any error in the registers must first be corrected through the Registry's rectification procedure under s. 78 of the International Companies Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Trade (Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce) in conjunction with VFSC for international company status
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Business Licence (Exempt/Offshore) for Export Wholesale Distribution of Pre-Packaged Food Products

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Environmental Registration/Exempt (no manufacturing or industrial effluent generation; operations limited to storage, sampling and re-export of pre-packaged goods)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions are generated; warehouse storage and trans-loading must comply with VU waste and spills regulations, including secondary containment for any incidental leakage. All packaging waste must be disposed through a licensed municipal waste contractor in accordance with Port Vila or Luganville municipal bylaws.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Service (Vanuatu Police Force fire section); structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works verifying flooring capacity for palletised loads; workplace occupational hygiene clearance from the Vanuatu Department of Labour, including proper ventilation, sanitation and safe handling procedures for food-grade packages.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Commission (Customs & Inland Revenue Division), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; statutory registrations effected through licensed Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) agents and filed on the VFSC e-Registry portal (www.vfsc.vu) and the Customs & Inland Revenue portal (customs.gov.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] via a licensed VFSC registered agent (no minimum capital, no local resident director required); (2) apply for a Vanuatu Tax Identification Number (TIN) from the Vanuatu Revenue Commission under the Revenue Administration Act 2022, attaching certificate of incorporation, registered-agent letter, and due-diligence copies of director and beneficial owner passports (TIN issued ~5 business days); (3) obtain an ASYCUDA World importer/exporter code from Customs for export declarations; (4) apply for a municipal business licence only if a physical presence is established in Port Vila or Luganville (offshore ICs with zero local activity are exempt). No income tax or VAT registration exists because Vanuatu levies no direct tax and no national VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections are available because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. Relevant statutory elections: (i) IC may elect tax-exempt non-resident status, obtaining an Exemption Certificate under the International Companies Act covering all income, capital gains, withholding, and stamp duties; (ii) election of the offshore/exempt business-licence category before the Port Vila or Luganville municipality; (iii) election under the Foreign Exchange Control Act to route foreign-currency settlements through licensed domestic banks or to maintain external foreign-currency accounts with central-bank approval.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT/GST system: None — Vanuatu operates without a national VAT, GST, or general sales-and-use tax; only municipal sales taxes (generally 5% in Port Vila and Luganville) apply to physical domestic retail consumption within municipal boundaries, and such taxes have no nexus over a non-resident IC exporting goods overseas.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable in Vatu (Vt): there is no national indirect-tax statute and therefore no turnover threshold for VAT/GST registration. The only in-country trigger is the municipal business-licence regime (first Vatu of local trading activity); 100% export sales settled in foreign currency are outside municipal sales-tax nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal-clearance, API, or digital-stamping mandate exists for VAT purposes in Vanuatu. Commercial invoices are self-issued; electronic control is limited to ASYCUDA World customs declarations, export-entry processing, and the TIN-based filing framework under the Revenue Administration Act 2022.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: De facto permanent 0% export treatment prevails by statutory design, as no VAT/GST is chargeable on exports from Vanuatu. To preserve this treatment for pre-packaged hotpot soup-base bricks (ISIC 4638), the exporter must: (i) ship the goods physically out of Vanuatu customs territory under a lodged ASYCUDA World export entry; (ii) hold a valid IC registration, TIN, and customs exporter code; (iii) sell to a non-resident buyer with title and risk transferring offshore; (iv) settle in freely convertible foreign currency via SWIFT TT or Letter of Credit; and (v) confine all activities to offshore operations so no municipal sales-tax nexus arises.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World export entry) duly processed and cleared
Commercial Invoice and packing list (HS headings 2103.90 / 2104.10, seasoning and soup preparations)
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or Airway Bill evidencing consignment to an overseas port
Certificate of Origin (only where required by the buyer's Letter of Credit)
Inward Remittance Certificate from the collecting Vanuatu bank, or a foreign-exchange transaction report, evidencing receipt of proceeds within the statutory period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating or over-invoicing attracts: (i) customs penalties under the Customs Act [Cap 145] of 100%–300% of the under-declared value; (ii) monetary penalties and imprisonment sanctions under the Revenue Administration Act 2022 for knowingly providing false information to the Vanuatu Revenue Commission; (iii) retrospective revocation of the IC's tax-exemption certificate and deregistration by the VFSC; (iv) exchange-control enforcement under the Foreign Exchange Control Act [Cap 67], including fines, restriction of future forex facilities, and compelled repatriation where proceeds are not received within 180 days. Directors and beneficial owners may be pursued jointly and severally.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), exercising prudential and foreign exchange administration under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 322]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licenses and supervises International Companies and payment service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VUV is freely convertible for current account and capital account transactions on a de facto basis. Vanuatu maintains no central bank prior-approval regime for profit remittances by non-resident controlled International Companies. Banks require board resolutions, underlying trade contracts, and source-of-funds evidence for each outward remittance to satisfy domestic AML/CFT obligations. Corporate tax exemption does not create any remittance restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, mandatory conversion, or repatriation timeline is imposed on export proceeds in Vanuatu. Exporters may keep foreign currency receipts in offshore or onshore foreign-currency accounts. For prudential recordkeeping, banks may require export declarations and freight documents within 30 to 90 days, but this is a customer due diligence measure, not an exchange control surrender rule.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to Medium. Offshore digital EMI providers are not licensed by RBV to hold settlement accounts in Vanuatu unless they obtain a banking or payment-services license under the Financial Institutions Act. A foreign fintech wallet may be used only as an auxiliary channel for e-commerce receipts; direct trade settlement through a non-resident EMI will trigger VFSC scrutiny and may be rejected by counterparty banks due to lack of a Vanuatu clearing relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are not required by statute to appear physically at a Vanuatu bank for an International Company. Remote account opening is permitted if the bank can obtain certified verification through a licensed VFSC-registered agent, a notary public, or a correspondent introducer. Physical appearance is rarely mandated but may be requested at the discretion of the bank's internal KYC policy, especially for signatories in high-risk jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or signatory resides in a FATF-listed high-risk jurisdiction, causing automatic enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passports; board resolution appointing signatory; detailed source-of-wealth statement; foreign bank reference letter issued within 90 days; tax residency certificate or cross-border income declaration; negative sanctions screening report; and a sworn affidavit explaining all background relationships.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Company is a newly incorporated International Company with little economic footprint or physical substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Non-disposal of beneficial ownership declaration; vertical trade-chain documentation (procurement contracts, warehouse receipts, inland transport arrangements, inspection certificates, export insurance policies); lease or virtual-office agreement; and a credible corporate business plan covering the hotpot base export cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: First inbound capital injection is unusually large relative to the stated trade volume.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Loan agreement or capital contribution resolution; bank statements of the remitting party showing the exact source of funds; independent accountant confirmation of net worth; customs export forecasts; and a legal opinion confirming membership interest under the International Companies Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cold introduction without a prior banking relationship or an unlicensed introducer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate KYC pack from a licensed VFSC agent; notarized minutes authorizing account opening; bank letter from an existing ANZ/BSP or foreign tier-1 banking counterpart; signed reliance letter agreeing to EDD conditions; and six months of corporate formation documents stamped by the VFSC.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant SWIFT MT103 routing from a shareholder or parent entity with purpose code 'CAPT' (capital contribution) or 'GDR' (trade finance under open account credits). Remittance must include the beneficiary IC name and account, and the paying bank must pass through a correspondent where necessary. The receiving Vanuatu bank will verify the economic substance of the transfer, require a board resolution for capital injection, and may request a certified extract from the VFSC register confirming the new shareholding.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements comprise (1) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for sample orders, documentary collections (DP/DA), and post-shipment balances; (2) commercial letters of credit (L/C at sight or usance) issued by a Vanuatu bank or a foreign confirming bank for bulk shipments of pre-packaged hotpot base containers, with full document presentation: commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, and health/customs certificates; and (3) cheque or local currency payment for incidental Vanuatu operating expenses.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright forward foreign exchange contracts with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer covering USD/CNY and VUV/USD exposures

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY offshore where the underlying import is denominated in RMB and the settled currency is USD or VUV, subject to the counterparty bank's internal product eligibility
Cross-currency swaps between CNY and USD or VUV for large inventory financing cycles, requiring ISDA documentation and board-approved treasury policy
FX swaps for working capital conversion between VUV, USD, and AUD when the operational account holds a temporary surplus in a non-functional currency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of Company Status, Directors, Members and Beneficial Ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory monetary penalties imposed on the Company and each defaulting director; persistent non-filing combined with unpaid annual licence fee triggers administrative strike-off by VFSC after expiry of the statutory notice period

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Licence Fee (Government Renewal / Franchise Payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the incorporation anniversary; VFSC invoice payable within 60 days from the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late-payment surcharge of 20% of the annual fee; continued non-payment for one year or more subjects the International Company to administrative strike-off and deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Attestation and Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent; VFSC upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the Annual Declaration; within 14 days after any share transfer or beneficial ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offence under Vanuatu beneficial ownership legislation; fines levied on the Company and its officers; share transfers unrecorded in the Register of Members treated as invalid against third parties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Service Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Contractually renewed on the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Resignation of the registered agent without replacement within 30 days gives VFSC grounds for strike-off of the International Company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. Vanuatu International Companies have no statutory audit obligation; no revenue, asset, or employee thresholds trigger a mandatory independent audit. A voluntary audit may be required by a shareholder resolution, bank facility agreement, or investor covenant for this pre-packaged food export distribution business.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Books and records must fairly present the financial position and transactions under section 96 of the International Companies Act Cap. 222; IFRS, US GAAP or other internationally recognized accounting frameworks are acceptable; no Vanuatu Local GAAP filing obligation applies to International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Company must maintain a current Beneficial Owner Register at its registered office. The licensed registered agent obtains a signed annual attestation from the beneficial owner confirming that no changes have occurred in shareholding, control, or beneficial ownership; any share transfer or UBO change must be notified to the agent within 14 days and endorsed in the Register of Members before the Annual Declaration is submitted to VFSC.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 6,000 (voluntary, if required by banks, counterparties or investors)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Vanuatu International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is wholly exempt from corporate income tax on foreign-source and offshore income. Vanuatu imposes no general corporate income tax on ICs, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no property tax, and no stamp duty on offshore contracts. The export distribution of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot soup base from an IC conduit is therefore subject to a 0% effective tax rate. The only recurrent statutory costs are the fixed VFSC annual renewal fee and the registered agent fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return form exists for International Companies in Vanuatu. The mandatory compliance instrument is the VFSC Annual Renewal and Agent's Declaration, submitted by the licensed Registered Agent via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online payment and registration portal. Export transactions additionally require a Vanuatu Customs Service export declaration for the physical outward movement of hotpot soup base.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC annual renewal fee must be settled on or before the anniversary of incorporation, with a one-month administrative grace period recognized by VFSC practice. No corporate income tax return deadline applies because no CIT return is required by law for an International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, IC number, registered office address in Port Vila, and registered agent licence number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners are not required to be disclosed on the public filing; the registered agent must retain a certified copy of the share register and the VFSC incorporation certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Share Capital and Business Scope Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, share classes, and a declaration that the company's gross income arises solely from international trade activities (exports of wholesale seasoning and sauce products).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must not carry on domestic Vanuatu trading; if any domestic sale of hotpot soup base occurs, the small-business licence requirement under the Business Licences Act may be triggered and the IC's tax-exempt status may be jeopardized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and passport details of at least one natural-person director and corporate secretary appointment details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and shareholders may be non-residents without Vanuatu tax identification numbers; nominee directors are permissible but must act under written declarations recorded by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, certificate of origin, and customs export declaration applying the correct HS heading for prepared seasonings and soup-based products.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Vanuatu IC must be named as exporter of record; payment rails must be limited to Swift_TT or Letter of Credit to ensure the export proceeds trail supports the tax-exempt offshore characterization.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the VFSC annual renewal fee incurs a penalty surcharge of 10% of the annual fee for the first month of delay, with additional monthly surcharges, followed by strike-off of the IC from the register. Continued operation while struck off is an offence under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and can result in fines on the company and the registered agent. No late CIT filing penalty exists because no CIT return is legally required.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] expressly shields distributions by an IC from any form of Vanuatu withholding tax. Dividend remittances to foreign shareholders require no TRC (Tax Residency Certificate), no VFSC dividend clearance, and no tax deduction at source. In practice, the IC resolves board minutes declaring the dividend, transfers funds via SWIFT or Letter of Credit settlement, and retains supporting board resolutions and bank evidence in the statutory records.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate on royalties: 0%. Statutory withholding tax rate on interest: 0%. No treaty rates apply because Vanuatu maintains no DTA network. Payments of trademark or brand royalties for the hotpot soup base brand and any intercompany shareholder loans may be remitted free of any Vanuatu WHT; taxation of those payments is solely a matter for the recipient's residence jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu's Income Tax Act and International Companies Act do not enact statutory transfer pricing rules and prescribe no Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Report thresholds in VUV. The IC is nonetheless expected to keep contemporaneous records evidencing arm's-length pricing in purchase and resale transactions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not apply an Economic Substance Regulations framework equivalent to those of the Gulf Cooperation Council states or the OECD Harmful Tax Practices regime as binding on ordinary wholesale International Companies. However, the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] mandates a physical registered office in Vanuatu, an appointed licensed registered agent, and maintenance of accounting records sufficient to explain all transactions. For the export distribution of pre-packaged hotpot soup base, the accepted substance profile requires real purchase contracts, inventory risk, logistics coordination, and wholesale invoicing from the IC to unaffiliated or affiliated distributors, rather than a bare invoice-passing shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Customs Declaration Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false export declarations, misdescribing the hotpot soup base to obtain an incorrect HS classification, under-declaring customs value to reduce statutory levies in the destination jurisdiction, or using the IC to conceal taxable turnover of a related trading entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Customs Act [Cap. 145] and the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2015, the offender is liable upon conviction to fines of up to VUV 1,000,000, forfeiture of the exported goods, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 10 years, and assessment of unpaid duty and VAT at triple the evaded amount. Additionally, the VFSC may strike the IC off for conducting illegal trading.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or direct fraudulent invoicing face personal criminal prosecution, fines, and imprisonment. Civil courts may pierce the corporate veil and order restitution of the evaded customs and tax amounts against a director's personal assets; serious cases may trigger director travel bans and extradition requests from the affected treaty partner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Misrepresentation and Bank Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Publishing the IC as a substantive international trading company to banks and trade counterparties while no real procurement, warehousing, quality inspection, or logistics functions are performed, and all operational substance is retained by a related Hong Kong or mainland Chinese affiliate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The International Companies Act [Cap. 222] empowers the VFSC to issue compliance directions, impose remedial fines, strike the IC off, and require the terminated registered agent to destroy the certificate of incorporation. Misrepresentation to a financial institution may constitute obtaining a banking facility by deception, punishable by fines and imprisonment under the Penal Code [Cap. 112].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign facility letters, KYC declarations, or trade finance undertakings containing false substance statements are personally liable under common law fraud and breach of fiduciary duty. Remedies include rescission of financing agreements, personal restitution of the lender's losses, disqualification as a director, and travel restrictions pending civil or criminal process.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC bank account as a pass-through vehicle for settlement of hotpot soup base trades where the invoiced payor is not the true counterparty, layering funds through multiple shell jurisdictions, or handling proceeds known or suspected to derive from smuggling or fraudulent food-safety certification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 41 of 2016, money laundering is punishable by imprisonment for up to 25 years and fines of up to VUV 50,000,000. The VFSC may suspend or revoke the IC registration, while the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze assets pending investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are treated as reporting persons and may incur personal criminal liability regardless of the corporate form. Asset forfeiture orders, travel bans, and personal imprisonment apply where the director arranged or deliberately ignored suspicious settlement patterns; nominee directors are equally liable where they “allow” the IC to be used for money laundering.
